physics.no_collider: A rigid body without a collider is excluded from simulation.
physics.trigger_not_simulated: The trigger box is excluded from physics simulation.
physics.sphere_scale_tip: Non-uniform scaling uses the largest axis.
physics.character_origin:
The origin is at the feet. Script controls:
SetMoveVelocity, Jump, IsGrounded.
physics.character_rigidbody:
This character also has a rigid body.
Use one of the two components.
physics.character_push: Controls how strongly the character pushes dynamic objects.

particles.radius_tip: Particles spawn randomly inside a sphere around the origin.
particles.local_velocity_tip: The direction follows the object's rotation.
particles.floor_tip: Particles bounce off a horizontal plane shown as an orange grid in the viewport.
particles.relative_floor_tip: On: height follows the emitter. Off: fixed world height (Y).
particles.bounce_tip: 0 = no bounce, 1 = bounce at full speed.
particles.floor_friction_tip: Slows sideways movement on each impact.
particles.default_texture: No texture. The default is a soft disc. Drag an image from the Asset Browser here.
particles.bar_active_tip: Emitters keep spawning particles. Off: only bursts and script particles.
particles.bar_loop_tip: Emission repeats after its duration. Off: stops after one pass.
particles.flipbook_tip:
Image containing multiple frames, in row order.
1 × 1 uses the full image.
particles.flipbook_custom_tip:
Custom frames are active.
Changing columns or rows switches back to the grid.
particles.flipbook_custom_active: Custom frames active – changing the grid resets them
particles.frame_range_warning: A stored frame index exceeds the atlas. Playback uses the nearest valid frame.
particles.clip_name_warning: Use a unique name with 1–64 characters. Duplicate names resolve to the first clip.
particles.preview_legend: Cross = pivot · Line = floor contact · Outline = frame 0
particles.frame_drag_tip: Drag a frame to move it, its bottom-right corner to resize, or the circle to move the pivot. Editing a grid creates individual pixel frames.
particles.grid_edit_limit: Reduce the grid to at most 4096 non-empty cells to edit individual frames.
physics.fit_box_tip:
Fits the box to the mesh bounds.

physics.box_from_mesh: Creates a box collider from the mesh bounds.
physics.default_box: Creates a 1 × 1 × 1 box, for example as a trigger zone.
physics.sphere_exists:

physics.sphere_from_mesh: Fits a sphere around the mesh bounds using the largest half-extent as the radius.

physics.enabled_tip:
Off: the object and its colliders are excluded from physics.
Settings are preserved.
physics.type_tip:
Static: stays in place and blocks other objects.
Dynamic: responds to gravity, forces and collisions.
Kinematic: follows the transform from scripts or animation
and pushes dynamic objects.
physics.ancestor_rigidbody:
Parent object “%s” already has a rigid body.
This rigid body is ignored.
physics.parent_position: With a parent, the position is converted to parent space at runtime.
physics.compound_tip:
Add more shapes as children.
Together they form one body, such as an L shape.
physics.rigidbody_owner: Belongs to the rigid body on “%s”
physics.static_obstacle: Without a rigid body, the collider acts as a static obstacle such as a wall or floor.
audio.spatial_tip:
Off: 2D at the same volume everywhere, e.g. music and UI.
On: volume decreases with distance from the listener.
particles.restart_tip: Restarts the preview. If the emitter is disabled, the burst is shown once.
particles.loop_duration_tip: Duration of one cycle. A new burst starts the next cycle.
particles.duration_tip: Particles are emitted at the selected rate for this duration, then emission stops.
particles.random_frame_tip:
On: each particle shows a random still frame, e.g. a puff of smoke.
Off: frames play over the particle's lifetime, e.g. an explosion.
physics.capsule_height_tip:
Overall height including both hemispheres.
Below twice the radius, the shape is a sphere.
physics.trigger_tip:
Triggers do not block objects or appear in raycasts.
Scripts receive OnTriggerEnter and OnTriggerExit
when another object enters or leaves the box.
physics.dynamic_help:
Simulated dynamically: can fall, roll and be pushed.
If no collider is present, a box is created automatically.
physics.box_child_tip:
Creates an empty child with a box collider.
Move and rotate it to build compound shapes such as an L shape.

inspector.visible_tip:
Toggles rendering for an entity with a mesh.
Systems and transforms continue to run.
inspector.persistent_tip:
This entity survives LoadScene() and UnloadScene().
Child entities need their own setting.
